toolbox.intro: The tools I reach for — each one used in the projects above, not just listed.

timeline.title: RFID employee tracking & access control
timeline.detail: Industrial access platform: ESP32 readers publish badge scans over MQTT into a Fastify decision engine (skill, machine, and schedule checks), with audit logs, alerts, attendance, and a realtime dashboard plus employee portal — containerized with PostgreSQL, Redis, EMQX, and nginx.

timeline.title: Sadine Tours — travel agency platform
timeline.detail: A production-oriented agency platform: Next.js storefront, admin ERP, and customer account in en/fr/ar over a Fastify/Prisma API — quotes-to-bookings state machine with audit trails, CMS pages, invoices, coupons, dashboards, and visa processing.

timeline.title: Documents Assistant — conversational RAG agent
timeline.detail: Final-year engineering project (PFE): a RAG assistant for project documentation with a TypeScript/Express API, a Python FastAPI AI service, hand-written retrieval, and a verification step against hallucination.

timeline.title: Wave — campus community app
timeline.detail: Expo React Native app for students and associations — events, carpooling, housing, deals, tutoring, stories, and realtime chat — backed by a TypeScript/Express API over PostgreSQL and MongoDB with a Redis push pipeline and Lydia payments.

timeline.title: Data Drift & Decision Intelligence System
timeline.detail: ML monitoring platform detecting distribution shifts with PSI and KS-tests, quantifying impact on model performance, and producing an executive retrain-or-monitor report.

philosophy.title: How I build software
philosophy.intro: A short manifesto on what makes AI software trustworthy.

principles.title: Evidence over claims
principles.body: If a number can't be traced to a repo, a test, or a benchmark, it doesn't go on the page. That standard applies to my models too: an answer is only as good as the evidence it cites.

principles.title: Reliability is the feature
principles.body: Rate limits, provider failures, and stale data are the real problems in AI products. Handling them is not polish — it's the core engineering.

principles.title: Ground every answer
principles.body: A fluent hallucination is worse than no answer. Verification steps, retrieval quality, and honest failure are how AI earns trust.

principles.title: Measure before you scale
principles.body: No benchmark, no claim. Retrieval quality and model degradation get measured before they get celebrated.

principles.title: Write for the reader
principles.body: Architecture should be explainable to a founder and rigorous for an engineer — in the same paragraph.
